meta.title: Careers
meta.description: Join a cleaning team in Luxembourg that values reliability, respect and care. Stable contracts, training and fixed schedules.

hero.title: Join a team that takes pride in the details
hero.intro: We are always looking for reliable, careful people to look after homes and workplaces across Luxembourg. Experience helps, but attitude matters most.

image.alt: Team members preparing for the day in a bright corridor

why.title: Respect for the people who do the work

items.title: Stable schedules
items.body: Regular clients and fixed time slots, so you can plan your life.

items.title: Training
items.body: Paid training on methods, products, materials and safety, from your first week.

items.title: A supportive team
items.body: A supervisor you can reach, and colleagues who cover for each other.

items.title: Proper contracts
items.body: Employment contracts under Luxembourg law, with [collective agreement] conditions.

items.title: Residential cleaners
items.body: Regular and one-off cleaning in private homes.

items.title: Housekeepers
items.body: Laundry, ironing and the day-to-day care of private residences.

items.title: Commercial cleaners
items.body: Offices, practices and public facilities, often early morning or evening.

items.title: Team leaders and supervisors
items.body: Experienced professionals who train, check quality and support teams.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Send the form below. A CV is welcome but not required.

steps.title: Phone call
steps.body: If your profile matches an opening, we call you for a short conversation.

steps.title: Interview
steps.body: We meet in person, talk about the job and check your documents.

steps.title: Start
steps.body: Training, then your first clients with a team leader at your side.

form.title: Apply now
form.intro: We read every application. Your data is used only for recruitment and kept for a limited time, as explained in our privacy policy.
